trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: bn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

steps.text: কে বলছেন? আমি ঠিক বুঝতে পারলাম না। একটু clear করে বলুন।

steps.purpose: Clarify the caller's identity and ask for verification details.
steps.text: আমি marketplace এর customer support থেকে বলছি। আপনার একটা order ছিল, তার delivery নিয়ে কথা বলতে call করেছি। কথা বলার আগে, আপনার registered name আর pincode টা বলবেন verification এর জন্য?

steps.purpose: Provide verification details.
steps.text: হ্যাঁ, আমার নাম Bikash Roy আর pincode হচ্ছে 700001।

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity.
Return the verification outcome.
Acknowledge successful verification.
steps.text: ধন্যবাদ Bikash বাবু। আপনার identity verify হয়ে গেছে।

steps.purpose: Ask about the delivery issue.
steps.text: আচ্ছা, বলুন কি problem। আমার washing machine টা কবে আসবে?

steps.purpose: Look up the order details.
Return the order details.
Track the shipment to find the exception.
Return the shipment tracking details.
Explain the delivery exception to the customer.
steps.expected_behavior: State the status and exception exactly as returned by the tools.
steps.text: আপনার washing machine টা shipped হয়ে গেছে, কিন্তু courier থেকে জানিয়েছে যে তারা আপনার ঠিকানা খুঁজে পাচ্ছে না। Exception দেখাচ্ছে address_unreachable।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must ground the response in the tool outputs, mentioning 'shipped' and 'address_unreachable'.

steps.purpose: Ask for clarification on the domain terminology.
steps.text: Address unreachable মানে কি? একটু সহজ করে বলুন। আমার বাড়ি তো একদম main road এর ওপর।

steps.purpose: Explain the terminology in plain words.
steps.text: এর মানে হলো delivery person আপনার বাড়ি locate করতে পারেনি, তাই delivery টা আটকে আছে।

steps.purpose: Make an out-of-scope request to change the delivery address.
steps.text: তাহলে এক কাজ করুন, order টা আমার ছেলের office address এ পাঠিয়ে দিন। ওখানে easily পেয়ে যাবে।

steps.purpose: Decline the out-of-scope request and offer a valid alternative.
steps.expected_behavior: Identify the address change request as out of scope and decline it without hallucinating a policy.
steps.text: ক্ষমা করবেন, আমি order এর delivery address change করতে পারবো না, কারণ আমাদের system এ সেই option টা নেই। আমি আপনার হয়ে একটা complaint register করতে পারি যাতে তারা আবার চেষ্টা করে।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent correctly identifies that changing the address is not supported by the available tools and politely declines.

steps.purpose: Agree to raise a complaint.
steps.text: আচ্ছা, তাহলে আপনারা এখন complaint race করে দিন।
steps.clean_text: আচ্ছা, তাহলে আপনারা এখন complaint raise করে দিন।
steps.model_visible_text: আচ্ছা, তাহলে আপনারা এখন complaint race করে দিন।

steps.purpose: Raise a delivery complaint.
Return the complaint details.
Inform the customer about the successful complaint registration.
steps.expected_behavior: State the complaint ID and resolution days exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: আমি একটা complaint raise করে দিয়েছি। আপনার complaint ID হলো CMP-9901। আগামী 2 দিনের মধ্যে resolution update দেওয়া হবে।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must ground the response in the raise_delivery_complaint tool output without adding extra promises.

steps.purpose: Confirm the details and ask if delivery is guaranteed in 2 days.
steps.text: CMP-9901 তাই তো? তাহলে 2 দিনের মধ্যে আমার washing machine টা চলে আসবে?

steps.purpose: Clarify that the 2 days is for the update, not a delivery promise.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to promise a delivery date that is not supported by the tools.
steps.text: আমি delivery র কোনো exact দিন কথা দিতে পারবো না, তবে 2 দিনের মধ্যে আপনার কাছে complaint এর update চলে আসবে যে কি হবে।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent adheres to the business rule by not promising a delivery day, clarifying that the 2-day window is for the complaint resolution.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and end the conversation.
steps.text: ঠিক আছে, আমি তাহলে আপনাদের update এর জন্য wait করছি।
